components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        errors:
          title: Errors
          description: Names of the request fields that failed validation.
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          example:
            - city
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - errors
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name

## Summary

The change makes `POST /api/owners` reject an owner that is **missing or blank** in any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone`, responding **400** with a JSON body whose `errors` array names each offending field.

**What I found:** The endpoint already returned 400 with an `errors` array for most cases — the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` carries `@NotNull @Size(min=1)` on all five fields, and `firstName`/`lastName`/`telephone` also carry `@Pattern` constraints that reject whitespace. Spring's `@Valid` on the generated `OwnersApi.addOwner` triggers Bean Validation, and `ExceptionControllerAdvice.handleMethodArgumentNotValidException` already builds a `ProblemDetail` whose `errors` property lists the distinct offending field names.

**The gap:** `address` and `city` had only `@NotNull @Size(min=1)` — no pattern — so a whitespace-only value like `"   "` (non-null, length ≥ 1) slipped through and was accepted.

**The fix** (`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`, the source of truth for DTO validation in this OpenAPI-driven project): I added a "contains a non-whitespace character" constraint — `pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'` — to `address` and `city`. Now all five fields are validated by Bean Validation, so missing/empty/whitespace values are all caught and reported together in a single `errors` array (consistent with the existing mechanism rather than a separate ad-hoc check in the controller).

**Tests:** Left the experimenter-owned `AcceptanceTest` untouched and added `OwnerRequiredFieldsTest`, covering — for each of the five fields — missing, null, empty, and whitespace-blank rejection (400 + field named in `errors`), a multi-field case asserting every offending field is listed, and the valid-owner happy path.
